chunks: For crops, up to the two sandal straps, and for palm trees, up to the two shins.

key_terms.الزَّرْعِ: cultivated crops or planted field produce
key_terms.السَّاقَيْنِ: the two shins, used as a measure of water depth
key_terms.الشِّرَاكَيْنِ: the two sandal straps, used as a measure of water depth

ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed water level for irrigating crops and palm trees in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This report gives a legal measure for water distribution in irrigation. It distinguishes between crops and palm trees, indicating different water levels appropriate to each in determining rightful flooding or watering.
